name: rafal-tools
description: Rafal's Claude Code tools. plugin-cost (/rafal-tools:plugin-cost): per-session token cost and real usage of every enabled plugin. task-tracker (/rafal-tools:task-tracker): per-folder task tracking across projects with an HTML Kanban board, import of progress from markdown plans, task dependencies (also across projects), data kept outside the repos, and token-cheap resume of unfinished work. security-audit (/rafal-tools:security-audit): phase-by-phase security audit of your own web, mobile and desktop apps — recon, test plan, code scan with free scanners, localhost verification with role accounts, abuse/load checks, and a prioritized English report in .security/.
